name: Ring Dip
steps: Set the rings near hip height and press down into a stable support with straight arms and rings beside your hips.
Bend your elbows back and lower until your upper arms approach horizontal or your shoulders reach their comfortable limit.
Press powerfully down through the rings to straighten your arms back to full lockout.
Turn the rings slightly outward at the top support position before starting the next repetition.
tips: Keep the rings close to your torso rather than letting them drift wide out to the sides.
Control the depth and tempo carefully because the unstable rings demand significant shoulder stability.
